subject: Literature
title: The Metamorphoses and Transformation Tales
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Metamorphoses and Transformation Tales usable.

hook.text: Ovid retold over two hundred and fifty myths in one epic poem, all connected by the theme of transformation.

buildup.text: The Metamorphoses gave us Narcissus, Icarus, Medusa, and dozens of other stories still told today.

discovery.text: Published around 8 AD, it became the most influential source of Greek mythology for all of Western culture.

twist.text: Emperor Augustus exiled Ovid, possibly because the poem's playful tone undermined his moral reform campaign.

climax.text: Ovid's retellings shaped Renaissance painting, Baroque opera, and modern literature's fascination with myth.

punchline.text: An exile's poem became Western culture's mythology Bible.

quiz.question: Why was Ovid exiled from Rome?
